viewing_check: Read the model and serial number on the bell or lower bow (YTS-23, YTS-25, YTS-26, YTS-275 or YTS-280 vary a lot in value), 'Made in Japan' or not, check the octave key and neck, pads (leaks, torn) and dents, whether the stand and mouthpiece are Yamaha, and test by blowing or playing.
